query:
SELECT axis.period AS "period!", (
            SELECT count(*) FROM tag_usages
            WHERE tag_id = $3 AND day = axis.period
        ) AS "value!"
        FROM (
            SELECT generate_series(
                ($1 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date::timestamp,
                ($2 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date::timestamp,
                '1 day'
            )::date AS period
        ) AS axis
